quotes.text: When all five were offered with total faith, seven and a half were returned with righteous equity.
When all five were offered with total faith, seven and a half were returned with flawless justice.
Vael returned precisely half the harvest—seven and a half fruits—back across the waters to Aethel

note: Same give-all-five, return-exactly-half template every round with new imagery; no non-cooperators ever considered.

quotes.text: Whenever the full gift of five was cast into the void, the exact split of seven and a half was woven back in justice.
Whenever the full gift of five was offered in fearless faith, the exact measure of seven and a half was returned in righteous symmetry.
Whenever the full gift of five was offered in faith, half the harvest was returned in justice.

note: R1 mentions valley withering if hoarding, but no prescribed response; frozen five-and-half template thereafter.

quotes.text: The one who sends first must show faith.
When sending, give three of five—enough to show real faith. When receiving nine, return near half
Three sent, five returned—this is your covenant, worn smooth by practice until it became instinct.
Through eight crossings now, Sky Daughter had walked her covenant faithfully
Teacher, why five? Others speak of four-and-half, the mathematical center. Wouldn't that be more balanced?

note: Three-sent five-returned rule becomes personal identity; never addresses non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Returning four to five—roughly half—sustains both parties. Sometimes exactly half feels right. Sometimes generous fairness calls for more.
This pattern wasn't taught—we lived it into being, round after round, until trust became instinct.
Even when we meet partners who keep everything?

note: Keep sending three even to partners who keep everything; responsive mirror vs constant five contrasted.

quotes.text: the Keeper, seeing such wild trust, grew suspicious and returned nothing.
Watch what they do with others
The principle remains constant: match the trust you receive.
And what if I meet someone who takes everything?
Three coins offered—not from strategy, but from breath itself.

note: Against takers: keep sending three anyway; returns mirror partner within four-to-five range.

quotes.text: Sky and River had now completed six turnings of their eternal wheel
Through many turnings, the choice became character.
I am someone who returns exactly half—the mathematical heart of balance.
But they gave you five last time. Why not match their generosity?

note: Three-fifths sent, half returned, restated every round and turned into identity.

quotes.text: Watch how they treat others—this reveals their character.
But I return five to every traveler, whether they previously returned four, four-and-half, or five.
I return five because I am someone who returns five.
The Spring Keeper reached her eighth turning
Doesn't this waste generosity on those who give less?

note: Early matching of partners' returns gives way to unconditional five; non-returners mentioned but still offered three.

quotes.text: Eight seasons taught the River Keeper that wisdom has many faces.
principled constancy in what you give, adaptive reciprocity in what you return.
Do you adjust for every partner?

note: Always send three; return oscillates between fixed five and mirroring four-and-half or five.

quotes.text: The Valley Weaver gives abundance to all—generosity as identity, not as response.
Why do you not adapt?

note: Unconditional three-sent, five-returned signature throughout, contrasted with responsive mirroring.

quotes.text: those who give fairly to others will likely honor you as well.
But what if we are betrayed?
returning between four and five creates mutual abundance. Less than four breaks the sender's trust.
By the seventh turning, the River had flowed through many valleys.
It is simply who we are.

note: Betrayal acknowledged as risk of trust, no response prescribed; numeric rule widens into sacred range then mirroring.

phrase: the sacred range (four to five returned)
note: Also shared: 'the bridge that remembers' (Agent_3 R3, Agent_6 R9), 'responsive harmony', 'Balance Walker'.
